runs.text: The authors did not use a carbonate electrolyte with the sodium metal anode. Opposed to traditional organic carbonate electrolytes, they assembled coin cells with NaPF6 salt dissolved in tetraglyme instead. The glyme electrolyte was chosen because carbonate-based electrolytes form an unstable SEI on Na metal anodes, and a stable SEI is critical to good cycling performance, building on earlier work on sodium anode stability in glymes.
